items.reply: Keep TP, specifically for negative limits newly affecting nonautomatic groups. At base, those groups ignored params[:limit]; at head, groups_controller.rb:22–26 unconditionally applies it, so limit=-1 now reaches PostgreSQL and produces a 500 during serialization. The reviewer correctly identifies oversized responses and unchecked limits on automatic groups as pre-existing, but that does not eliminate the newly introduced failure for nonautomatic groups.
